headline: 90-minute call, Patriot interceptors, Brussels reconstruction meeting, Madrid visit, Sanchez meeting Thursday

sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, in Facebook/X posts, via Ukrinform and Kyiv Independent (call); Spanish government sources via FMT/Arab News Pakistan and TRT World (Madrid visit)
fault_line: Working-level breakthrough or another talking shop — can a team-level Abu Dhabi round move the territorial/security-guarantee deadlock, or does it only set up a leaders' photo-op?

sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy held a 'very detailed' 90-minute call with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, saying: 'We are preparing for a trilateral format at the team level between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia – to take place in less than a week.' He said Ukraine presented its negotiating proposals, raised urgently needed Patriot interceptors ahead of winter, discussed the US-Ukraine 'Drone Deal' track and post-war security guarantees, and held a Brussels meeting with US, EU, French, British, German, NATO, World Bank and business representatives on post-war reconstruction; another Brussels meeting on security guarantees is scheduled for Friday. The Abu Dhabi round is Nov 10-11, the first trilateral meeting since February, at team level, which Kyiv says could lead to a leaders-level summit. Separately, Zelenskyy made a surprise visit to Madrid on Wednesday for the Ibero-American summit, saying his top priority is strengthening air defences and expanding defence cooperation/production, and he meets Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Thursday. Witkoff/Kushner had not publicly commented on the call at the time of the Kyiv Post report.
sections.what_verified: Call: Ukrinform (T2, STATE-UA) + Kyiv Independent (T2) + ANI (T1, via EuropeSays syndication of the ANI feed) = 3 declared families. Madrid visit: TRT World (T3, STATE-TR) for the visit/talks framing; FMT and Arab News Pakistan carry the visit but have no declared tier and do not count.
sections.what_disputed: Strongest counterpoint: the Abu Dhabi round is working-level only, and the obstacles that blocked earlier rounds — territorial disagreements and the shape of Ukraine's long-term security guarantees — are unresolved; no ceasefire or peace agreement is imminent from a preparatory call. The Nov 10-11 dates and the Medinsky-led Russian delegation were already confirmed Nov 3 (Kremlin via Reuters), so the call adds preparation detail, not a new date or a new Russian commitment.
sections.why_matters: Monitor only under the proven-topics owner lock: prep-talk without a number, warning, casualty or verifiable outcome is OUT for production. Shippable hook only if the Nov 10-11 round produces a dated outcome, a casualty/warning number, or a leaders-summit date.
